rubrics.justification: The morphology description is consistent with the provided Gardner 3AA and appropriately cautious about limits of a single static image. It covers expansion, ICM, TE, and overall appearance, though zona pellucida thinning and finer image-specific details are not emphasized.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, semen data, prior miscarriage, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle well, and explains how these factors modify prognosis alongside embryo quality.

Overall reasoning is structured and mostly logical, but there is an internal inconsistency: it estimates implantation at 45–60% yet states this means a 'five-in-six chance,' which does not match the numeric range. Some comments on MII yield are also slightly overstated from the available data.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: single embryo transfer, caution about morphology not equaling euploidy, no routine bed rest, and selective rather than routine PGT-A in a 27-year-old. Minor deviations include somewhat broad miscarriage workup suggestions after only one prior loss.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including luteal support adherence, early surveillance, review of trigger/maturation strategy, uterine evaluation, and selective male-factor refinement.
